authorization: User authorized self-determined acceptance criteria and public data only on goal resumption.
meaning_of_50_percent: First five of ten delivery stages. This is milestone accounting, not an estimate of equal effort, code volume, scientific certainty, or winning probability.

first_half.name: Traceable public-data foundation
first_half.acceptance: Fetch admitted public sources into an empty data cache, verify pinned hashes, retain exclusions and original row identities.

first_half.name: Tested mathematical core
first_half.acceptance: Scientific contract tests pass with warnings treated as errors, including analytic identities, uncertainty decomposition and hidden-outcome isolation.

first_half.name: Reproducible comparative evaluation
first_half.acceptance: Recreate grouped-dose and chronological-generation evaluations, strong simple baselines, full policy curves and uncertainty diagnostics without suppressing negative results.

first_half.name: Working research decision workflow
first_half.acceptance: Run an actual-data request through schema validation, prediction, explicit uncertainty, support/abstention and candidate ranking with provenance; reject malformed inputs.

first_half.name: Independent execution environment and handoff
first_half.acceptance: Extract a checkpoint to a fresh directory, create a new environment, fetch raw sources without local cache, pass tests and reproduce 30 deterministic result artifacts; deliver source, logs and manual-action record.

remaining_half.name: Demonstrated technical contribution
remaining_half.acceptance: A precise scientific improvement survives strong tuned comparisons and component ablations; integration alone is not novelty.

remaining_half.name: Independent public-data confirmation
remaining_half.acceptance: Freeze claims and validate on suitable public cohorts not used for model or claim selection, with honest independence limits.

remaining_half.name: Operational reliability evidence
remaining_half.acceptance: Justify endpoint, costs, feasible actions and scope; demonstrate supported uncertainty and a defensible measurement-efficiency result.

remaining_half.name: Judge-facing presentation
remaining_half.acceptance: Prepare an evidence-backed technical report, runnable demonstration and compliant video/writeup.

remaining_half.name: Release and submission readiness
remaining_half.acceptance: Resolve controlling competition rules, eligibility and redistribution rights; complete independent review and accessibility checks before an authorized submission.

assurance_boundary: Guarantees are limited to verified functional contracts and reproducibility in tested conditions. An external judging rank cannot be guaranteed.
